summary: Vertical Aerospace filed a Form 6-K reporting its September 11, 2026 AGM, where shareholders approved proposals including a special resolution amending the articles to grant Mudrick Capital Management, the largest shareholder, director nomination, removal and consent rights. Attendance represented 56.71% of voting power. Voters also approved increasing the 2021 Incentive Award Plan by 2,767,806 shares and repricing options to $1.30 from $3.50/$5.82. A related proposal to remove references to Stephen Fitzpatrick failed because his shares did not vote in favor. The governance changes signal Mudrick's increased control.
